BIO-02.title: mRNA vaccines for infectious diseases — advances, challenges and opportunities

cards.claim: 主要RNA形式包括非复制型线性mRNA和自扩增mRNA，另有探索中的形式。
cards.quote: Non-replicating (linear) mRNA, with or without modified nucleosides, and self-amplifying mRNA

cards.claim: mRNA结构和化学修饰影响稳定性、翻译效率及炎症反应。
cards.quote: half-life, stability, translatability and inflammatory capacity

cards.claim: 脂质纳米颗粒保护并递送mRNA，同时具有免疫刺激作用。
cards.quote: phospholipid (helper lipid), cholesterol, polyethylene glycol

cards.claim: 人体接种可有反应原性，动物模型难以充分预测；安全性与免疫原性需要平衡。
cards.quote: mRNA-LNP vaccines trigger systemic inflammatory responses

cards.claim: 肌注疫苗通常难以在上呼吸道诱导强黏膜免疫，黏膜递送仍是研发挑战。
cards.quote: do not induce robust antibody responses in the URT

cards.claim: 冷链、价格和产能等因素影响全球公平获取。
cards.quote: access to mRNA vaccines in low-income and middle-income countries

cards.claim: 下一代研发目标包括更低反应原性、更高稳定性和黏膜免疫。
cards.quote: increased immunogenicity and decreased reactogenicity

cards.claim: 综述记录了自扩增mRNA疫苗ARCT-154在日本获批的进展，不能推广到全部自扩增平台。
cards.quote: ARCT-154 was licensed in Japan

cards.claim: 新冠mRNA疫苗诱导的抗体在最初下降后可趋于稳定，不能简单断言毫无长期免疫。
cards.quote: they eventually become stable

cards.claim: 编码抗原在细胞中表达，随后被免疫系统识别并触发反应。
cards.quote: express the encoded antigens, which are then recognized by the immune system

cards.claim: 反应原性和免疫原性可能相互关联，减少接种不适时也需评估免疫效果。
